text:
Predicates:
Podcast(x) ::: x is a podcast.
Novel(x) ::: x is a novel.
Person(x) ::: x is a person.
American(x) ::: x is American.
AmericanCity(x) ::: x is an American city.
WrittenBy(x, y) ::: x is written by y.
Writer(x, y) ::: x is a writer of y.
NovelWriter(x) ::: x is a novel writer.
Created(x, y) ::: x created y.
BornIn(x, y) ::: x is born in y.
Premises:
¬Novel(podcast) ::: A podcast is not a novel.
∀x (AmericanCity(x) → American(x)) ::: If a person is born in American City, the person is American.
∀x ∀y (Novel(x) ∧ WrittenBy(x, y) → NovelWriter(y)) ::: If a book is novel and it is written by a person, then the person is a novel writer.
American(daniShapiro) ∧ Writer(daniShapiro, familyHistory) ::: Dani Shapiro is an American writer.
WrittenBy(familyHistory, daniShapiro) ::: Family History is written by Dani Shapiro.
Novel(familyHistory) ∧ WrittenBy(familyHistory, year2003) ::: Family History is a novel written in 2003.
Created(daniShapiro, familySecrets) ::: Dani Shapiro created a podcast called Family Secrets.
AmericanCity(boston) ::: Boston is an American city.
Conclusion:
Novel(familySecrets) ::: Family Secrets is a novel.
